name: Ducati 250 / 350 / 450 singles
engine: 248 to 436 cc air-cooled bevel-drive single, one carb, valve springs or desmo
intro: Ducati's bevel singles. Narrow-case and wide-case engines, a single carb and parts you will source from specialists.

H: The bevel-drive cams are set with shims and need patience. Check the bevel gear backlash and the valve shims before you run it hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
